accepted.quote: The boom length must not exceed 65% of the wingspan for airplanes or 75% of the rotor blade diameter for helicopters.

accepted.quote: For all applications, applicators are required to use a fine to medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572.I).

accepted.summary: prohibition on application during temperature inversions
accepted.quote: Do not apply during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: consider using nozzles designed to reduce drift

accepted.summary: follow nozzle manufacturers recommendations for setting up nozzles
accepted.quote: Follow nozzle manufacturers recommendations for setting up nozzles.

accepted.summary: orient nozzles parallel with airflow in flight to reduce fine droplets
accepted.quote: Generally, to reduce fine droplets , nozzles should be oriented parallel with the airflow in flight.

accepted.summary: consider using shielded sprayers
accepted.quote: Consider using shielded sprayers.

accepted.summary: verify shields are not interfering with uniform deposition of spray
accepted.quote: Verify that the shields are not interfering with the uniform deposition of the spray on the target area

accepted.summary: avoid applications during temperature inversions
accepted.quote: Avoid applications during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: avoid applications during gusty wind conditions
accepted.quote: AVOID APPLICATIONS DURING GUSTY WIND CONDITIONS.

accepted.summary: applicators need to be familiar with local wind patterns and terrain
accepted.quote: Applicators need to be familiar with local wind patterns and terrain that could affect spray drift.

accepted.summary: use larger droplets in hot and dry conditions to reduce evaporation effects
accepted.quote: When making applications in hot and dry conditions, use larger droplets to reduce effects of evaporation.

accepted.quote: Do not apply this product through any type of irrigation system.

accepted.applies_to: cotton aerial application in AZ and CA

accepted.quote: By air: Apply in a minimum spray volume of 2 gal/A (5 gal/A in AZ and CA).

accepted.summary: Pre-harvest interval of 7 days
accepted.quote: Do not harvest cotton until 7 days after an application of this product.

accepted.summary: Do not apply if temperature is below 65°F (implied by 'Cool but above 65°F' condition)
accepted.quote: Cool but above 65°F or Rank cotton

accepted.quote: Dry and 75°to 80°F

accepted.quote: Hot and dry 80°F or higher

accepted.summary: Do not apply if rain expected within 6 hours
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product if rain is expected within 6 hours as product performance may be reduced.

accepted.summary: Do not plant back another crop within 30 days after application
accepted.quote: Do not plant back another crop within 30 days after application.

accepted.applies_to: small grains planted within 30 days or between treated cotton rows
accepted.summary: Small grains planted early or between rows can only be used as cover crops; do not harvest for food or feed
accepted.quote: If small grains are planted earlier than 1 month after an [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application or are planted between the cotton plant rows which were treated with this product, these crops can only be used as cover crops. Do not harvest the grain crops for food or feed.

accepted.summary: Recommendation to apply defoliant before Ethephon for rank cotton
accepted.quote: It is recommended that an application of a defoliant be made BEFORE an [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application to facilitate boll and foliage coverage by this product.

accepted.summary: Allowed tank-mix partners for Ethephon E-AG 6
accepted.quote: [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] may be applied as a tank mixture or in sequence with the following products: Def ®, Folex®, Dropp®, Dropp® Ultra, Ginstar®, Harvade®, Methyl Parathion, Guthion®, and Malathion®.

accepted.summary: Refer to tank-mix partner label for precautions and rates
accepted.quote: Refer to the label of the tank mix partner for use precautions and use rates.

accepted.summary: Caution: slight reduction in boll opening may occur with defoliant tank mixes
accepted.quote: Use caution when this product is applied as a tank mix with defoliants as a slight reduction in boll opening could occur.

accepted.summary: Only tank mix with desiccants if plant desiccation is required
accepted.quote: Only apply this product as a tank mix with desiccants if plant desiccation is required.

accepted.summary: Do not use defoliant unless sufficient mature unopened bolls are present
accepted.quote: Do not use a defoliant unless sufficient mature unopened bolls are present to produce the desired yield.

accepted.summary: Do not tank mix with desiccants if cotton is to be spindle harvested
accepted.quote: DO NOT TANK MIX THIS PRODUCT WITH DESICCANTS IF COTTON IS TO BE SPINDLE HARVESTED.

accepted.summary: Do not mix with ammonium thiosulfate due to toxic fumes
accepted.quote: DO NOT MIX THIS PRODUCT WITH AMMONIUM THIOSULFATE AS THESE MIXTURES MAY RESULT IN FORMATION OF TOXIC FUMES.

accepted.summary: Tank mixtures with desiccants containing sodium chlorate could form hypochlorous acids emitting toxic chloride fumes on heating
accepted.quote: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, TANK MIXTURES OF [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] WITH DESICCANTS CONTAINING SODIUM CHLORATE COULD RESULT IN THE FORMATION OF HYPOCHLOROUS ACIDS WHICH ON HEATING WILL EMIT TOXIC CHLORIDE FUMES.

accepted.summary: Pre-conditioner application 4 to 7 days before boll-opening application
accepted.quote: Make application 4 to 7 days before the [Ethephon E- AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] boll -opening application.

accepted.summary: Defoliant tank mix used as sequential treatment, not in place of boll-opening treatment
accepted.quote: Defoliant tank mix applications are to be used as a sequential treatment with, not in place of, the [Ethephon E -AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] boll- opening treatment.

accepted.summary: Full label rate of Folex or Dropp permitted in tank mix
accepted.quote: A full label rate of Folex or Dropp is permitted.

accepted.summary: Ground application minimum spray volume 10 gal/A for Folex tank mix
accepted.quote: By ground:  Apply in a minimum spray volu me of 10 gal/A.

accepted.quote: For [Ethephon E -AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] Plus Folex: Apply by air in a minimum spray volume of 5 gal/A.

accepted.quote: For [Ethephon E -AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] Plus Dropp: Apply by air in a minimum spray volume of 3 gal/A (5 gal/A in AZ and CA).

accepted.summary: Pre-conditioner application 4 to 7 days before defoliant tank mix application
accepted.quote: Make application 4 to 7 days before a defoliant tank mix is applied.

accepted.summary: Pre-conditioner helps defoliate top of crop and preserves bottom (may lead to earlier harvest)
accepted.quote: This application helps defoliate the top of the crop and preserves the bottom of the crop (may lead to earlier harvest).

accepted.summary: Ground application minimum spray volume 10 gal/A for pre-conditioner
accepted.quote: By ground: Apply in a minimum spray volume of 10 gal/A.

accepted.summary: Aerial application minimum spray volume 2 gal/A for pre-conditioner (5 gal/A in AZ and CA)
accepted.quote: By air:  Apply in a minimum spray volume of 2 gal/A (5 gal/A in AZ and CA).

accepted.summary: Select application equipment and spray volumes to ensure thorough coverage of bolls and foliage
accepted.quote: In all tank mix options, select the type of application equipment (air or ground) and spray volumes which will ensure thorough coverage of bolls and foliage.

accepted.summary: Do not exceed 2.0 lb AI/A per year through combined or repeated uses of any ethephon products
accepted.quote: Do not exceed a maximum of 2.0 lb AI/A (2-2/3 pints/A) of this product per year through combined or repeated uses of any ethephon products.

accepted.summary: rain expected within 6 hours
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product if rain is expected within 6 hours as product performance may be reduced.

accepted.summary: major storm expected
accepted.quote: If a major storm is expected, delay application of this product.

accepted.summary: use only recommended additives
accepted.quote: Use only the recommended additives with [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] which are mentioned on this label.

accepted.summary: plant another crop within 30 days
accepted.quote: Do not plant another crop within 30 days after [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application.

accepted.unit: lb ethephon AI per acre per year
accepted.summary: exceed 2 lb ethephon AI per acre per year
accepted.quote: Do not exceed more than of 2 lb ethephon AI per acre per year.

accepted.summary: harvest within 24 to 72 hours after application
accepted.quote: Within 24 to 72 hours after the [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application, mature, sprayed leaves will begin to turn yellow, but the exact timing is dependent on the weather so that under cooler temperatures, yellowing will be delayed while under warm, sunny conditions, yellowing occurs faster.

accepted.summary: monitor weather and leaf color to determine harvest timing
accepted.quote: Monitor weather conditions and intensity of tobacco leaves color to determine timing of harvest.

accepted.summary: usually harvest within 48 hours
accepted.quote: Usually within 48 hours after the [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application, the leaves have reached the desired color intensity and can be harvested.

accepted.summary: harvest before over-ripening
accepted.quote: To avoid reduced yields and quality, harvest the tobacco before it over-ripens in the field after a [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application.

accepted.summary: apply to mature leaves for best results
accepted.quote: For best results, apply this product to mature leaves.

accepted.summary: test leaf maturity before application
accepted.quote: The correct timing for application can be tested by spraying a few plants in several different locations of the field.

accepted.summary: leaves yellow within 24 to 72 hours if mature
accepted.quote: If the leaves begin to yellow within 24 to 72 hours, the leaves are mature.

accepted.summary: do not apply if leaves do not change color within 72 hours
accepted.quote: If some treated leaves do not change color within 72 hours, do not apply this product until another test is carried out to determine if the leaves are mature.

accepted.summary: prepare test spray solution: 1 tsp product to 1 qt water
accepted.quote: To prepare a test spray solution, add 1 tsp. of this product to 1 qt. water.

accepted.summary: apply about 1 oz test spray solution as fine mist
accepted.quote: Apply about 1 oz. of the test spray solution as a fine mist and thoroughly cover the leaves.

accepted.summary: remove yellowed leaves before application
accepted.quote: Remove yellowed leaves before making a [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application as this will help yields and prevent leaf drop.

accepted.summary: higher rates only if temperatures below 65ºF on day of application
accepted.quote: If the higher rates are used, only apply if temperatures are below 65ºF on the day of application.

accepted.summary: cure treated and untreated leaves in separate barns
accepted.quote: However, [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator]-treated leaves cure faster, so cure treated and untreated leaves in separate barns.

accepted.summary: minimum spray volume 50 gal/A for directed spray
accepted.quote: Apply this product in a minimum spray volume of 50 gal/A.

accepted.summary: apply with drop nozzles and TG or OC spray tips at 50-60 gal/A, 35-40 psi, 2-3 mph
accepted.quote: Apply this product with drop nozzles and TG or OC spray tips designed to apply 50 to 60 gal/A at 35 to 40 psi and at tractor speed of 2 to 3 mph.

accepted.summary: 2 nozzles per row placed low enough to direct spray to leaves
accepted.quote: Adjust the sprayer so that there are 2 nozzles per row placed low enough to direct the spray to the leaves.

accepted.summary: harvest when 20% or more leaves have yellowed
accepted.quote: For this type of application, harvest when 20% or more of the leaves have yellowed.

accepted.summary: minimum spray volume 40 gal/A for over-the-top
accepted.quote: Apply this product in a minimum spray volume of 40 gal/A.

accepted.summary: apply only to mature leaves left on stalk
accepted.quote: Make applications only to the mature leaves left on the stalk.

accepted.summary: use test procedure to determine if remaining leaves are mature
accepted.quote: Use the test procedure described in the “Application Timing” section above to determine if remaining leaves are mature and will respond to applications of this product.

accepted.summary: apply lower rate for mature crop or minimum ripening inducement
accepted.quote: Apply the lower rate of this product for mature crop or if experience indicates that a minimum ripening inducement is required.

accepted.summary: higher rate for heavy rank crops or lower than normal temperatures
accepted.quote: The higher rate is used for heavy, more rank crops or when temperatures are lower than normal.

accepted.summary: apply over-the-top spray as fine mist using three nozzles
accepted.quote: Apply over-the-top spray as a fine mist using three nozzles (one nozzle tip over the center of the plant, and one on each side) so all leaves are thoroughly covered, similar to the application pattern of systemic sucker control agents.

accepted.summary: spray pressure 40 to 60 psi
accepted.quote: Use a spray pressure of 40 to 60 psi.

rejected.quote: Do not apply more than 2.0 lb ethephon AI per acre per year.
